Proof sketch I checked: by completion_exact, worker i's start after m completions has V_i = V_i(s) + m. While the exit test is false, the counts are below the floor vector at tstar in some coordinate (otherwise hready and harmonic_mono would give exit), so some completion is <= tstar and earliest picks it. Event times and Bf depend only on V and the starts, not on X, sel, jv or z, which justifies the exists-before-forall. Induction over rounds uses tstar = tbar_{k+1} (finite by hfin with top propagation). floor_min_attained puts tbar_{k+1} in its set; monotonicity gives floors from c_k >= floors from tbar_k; harmonic_mono with S/n <= eta <= HM gives hready. Then iterate_congr identifies the selected point with iterate ... j, and rounds >= K are filled with a harmonicReady schedule (e.g. B_i = S, valid since n <= S). No tie order is assumed: Bf is existential.

Proof-mode hints:
- round_step_h's invariant needs completion_exact's equality V(start_i) = V(s) + m_i.
- Termination of the round within E events uses hready together with harmonic_mono.
- The count bound in execute_malenia uses Bf_i <= V_i c - V_i s summed over rounds, plus integrality.
Ties: round_step_h and execute_malenia quantify Bf/B existentially, so no tie order is assumed beyond earliest's lowest-index rule (my earlier uniformalg note).
